# judgekeeper

> Check your LLM-as-a-judge in 5 steps: Find. Mark. Measure. Fix. Re-check. An LLM-as-a-judge is an AI model that grades the answers of another AI model, Pass or Fail, with a rule you wrote. judgekeeper shows how often it agrees with you. It is an open-source command-line tool that runs on your own computer.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.judgekeeper.com/): what judgekeeper is, a demo of the marking page, and what each of the 5 steps prints in the terminal
- [Guide](https://www.judgekeeper.com/start.html): install with `pip install judgekeeper` and run `judgekeeper` in your project (or `uvx judgekeeper` with uv), then the 5 steps: `judgekeeper` finds your eval results and opens the marking page, you mark answers Pass or Fail, `judgekeeper` shows your result, `judgekeeper fix` shows where your judge goes wrong and, for promptfoo, DeepEval, Inspect AI and MLflow, tests a better rule on marks kept aside (for your own CSV or JSONL file or `judgekeeper.record()`, you change the rule in your eval, run it, then `judgekeeper check`), and `judgekeeper check` re-checks your LLM-as-a-judge after a change; then keys and costs, your own CSV or JSONL format or one `judgekeeper.record()` line in your eval code, and how to start over or stop
- [Check in your browser](https://www.judgekeeper.com/check.html): drop a results file from promptfoo or DeepEval, or your own CSV, TSV or JSONL file, and see judgekeeper's first check on it; the file is read in the page and never sent anywhere
- [Privacy](https://www.judgekeeper.com/privacy.html): what this website and judgekeeper do with your data
